title: Unique Dry Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A fresh and flavorful Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb, tomato juice, and spices, perfect for a crowd, this recipe is also low in glycemic index and brine-dried for added texture.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together tomato juice, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days.
Reheat the kebabs in the oven or on the grill until heated through.
